verdict.rationale: Every skill's `SKILL.md` must include a `name` and `description` (docs-13). Codex loads those first and pulls in the full instructions only when it decides to use the skill (docs-49), so the description is the documented basis for activation. The skill creator explicitly asks what the skill does and when it should trigger (docs-7), and installed skills can be browsed via `/skills` or the desktop Skills sidebar (docs-20, docs-29); a hands-on install confirmed valid frontmatter (probe-rt-2). Missing for 10: no required, structured "when it activates" field separate from the free-text description; activation remains a model decision rather than deterministic and predictable; no evidence that curated or plugin-bundled skills consistently document their triggers.
